html: שׁרב (√ of foll., parch; NH שָׁרַב be scorched (by sun), שָׁרָב parching heat (of sun); Ecclus 43:22 דשן שרב parched grass; Aramaic שְׁרַב, שְׁרֵיב, ܫܪܰܒ, ܫܪܶܒ be parched, שְׁרַב heat, drought: cf. prob. also Assyrian n.pr. div. Šarrabu (-pu) ZimKAT 3, 415; > cp. Arabic سَرَابٌ mirage (RobBR i. 42] Ges Is 35, 7 al.; see against this especially CheIntrod. Is. 269).
